System Overview

Agility is a global CMMS solution designed to help organizations manage assets, processes, and people. It offers strong analytical tools and dashboards to help maintenance managers make data-driven decisions and improve operational efficiency.

💡 Editor's Verdict

Agility is a comprehensive maintenance solution with strong usability (8.5/10). Its combination of Customizable Dashboards, Work Order Management, Preventive Maintenance makes it a top consideration for modernizing plant operations.

Target Recommendation: Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, Logistics maintenance and reliability teams.

Frequently Asked Questions

❓ What industries is Agility best suited for?

Agility is optimized for Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, Logistics, Facilities maintenance and operations teams requiring Cloud / SaaS and On-Premise infrastructure.

❓ How does Agility handle work orders and preventive maintenance?

Agility provides end-to-end maintenance coordination, supporting reactive work order ticketing, recurring PM schedules, parts tracking, and technician mobile execution.

❓ What is the pricing model for Agility?

Agility operates on a Subscription pricing model.
